hints.title: Find the similar triangles made by the diagonals
hints.body: Because SR is parallel to PQ, triangles XSR and XQP are similar. Their corresponding bases have ratio SR:PQ=3:12=1:4.
hints.recap: Parallel lines give equal corresponding angles; similar triangles have a common scale for corresponding lengths.
hints.pitfall: The diagonal intersection is not generally halfway between the bases.
hints.pause: Use the similarity to find the ratio SX:XQ.

recall.reminder: Parallel lines give equal corresponding angles; similar triangles have a common scale for corresponding lengths.

hints.title: Convert parts into a whole
hints.body: The first similarity ratio compares the two pieces on opposite sides of X; add those pieces before comparing a piece with its entire diagonal.
hints.recap: Convert a ratio of two parts into a fraction of their whole before using a second length scale.
hints.pitfall: A part-to-part ratio differs from a part-to-whole ratio.
hints.pause: Find the similarity scale between SUX and SPQ.

recall.reminder: Convert a ratio of two parts into a fraction of their whole before using a second length scale.

hints.title: Recover both portions
hints.body: Repeat the diagonal-ratio approach for RXT. The requested segment runs from U through X to T.
hints.recap: Match corresponding sides in each similar pair, then combine the lengths along the required segment.
hints.pitfall: One portion alone does not complete the length.
hints.pause: Calculate both portions and combine them.

recall.reminder: Match corresponding sides in each similar pair, then combine the lengths along the required segment.

solution:
Similarity of XSR and XQP gives SX/XQ=RX/XP=1/4. Hence SX/SQ=RX/RP=1/5.

Since UX is parallel to PQ, triangles SUX and SPQ give UX=12/5. Similarly, triangles RXT and RPQ give XT=12/5.

Therefore UT=UX+XT=24/5=4.8. Answer C.
knowledgePattern: Use two scales of similar triangles across intersecting trapezium diagonals
